name: Lishi Tools (decode + pick)
description: Lishi tools are specialized 2-in-1 instruments that simultaneously pick and decode a lock cylinder — revealing the key's bitting while opening the lock. Originally designed for automotive locksmiths, they are widely used in physical red teaming. A Lishi tool opens the lock and returns the full key code as a byproduct, enabling key duplication for persistent re-entry. They are keyway-specific, so engagement planning must account for which Lishi profiles match the target's hardware.

blue.det: Tool profile visible in keyway; time at door; decoded bitting can enable key duplication.
blue.cm: Restricted/patented keyways prevent unauthorized duplication; key control policies and audit logs; high-security cylinders.
